Titulo: External Intermittence – Microsoft 365 Incident – Outlook / Exchange
Resumen:
Dear Team,

We are experiencing delays in receiving and responding to emails due to an ongoing incident affecting Microsoft 365 services, particularly Outlook / Exchange Online.

This issue may affect the timely reception and processing of emails sent to Monnet Payments, resulting in delays in our response times.

Microsoft is currently investigating the incident. Our team is monitoring the situation and working to minimize its impact on our customer communications.

We will provide further updates as soon as relevant information becomes available.

Best regards,
